name: innstilt-app
description: Innstilt as an Android app (Capacitor wrapper around ../web)

scripts.sync: node prepare-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -q
scripts.phone: export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home}" ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && npm run build && $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && $ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb shell monkey -p app.innstilt -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null
